Hero_Desc_Canna:
Suppression Unit Chief of the elven city, Monatium.
It looks like she was a high-ranking soldier before coming to Elias.
If it's an order from a superior, she follows it without question.
Album_Wish_Canna: Going on a perfect vacation with no emergency calls.
Album_Canna1: A police-like elf in charge of all safety and security in the elven city. Since her approach was rather extreme, however, it instills fear among the locals. She is an elf who completely believes the commands from the above, showing a soldier-like demeanor.
Album_Canna2: In the early days, Canna used a bow instead of a gun in the elven city, which fits the image I had in mind when I heard this. She also brags a bit pompously about shooting three flying birds with a single arrow.
Album_Canna3: Canna is very popular among those under her, and unlike her public persona, she is said to care deeply for them. Do you think she even has any leadership expertise? After all, her team calls her the "Idol Suppressor..."
Album_Canna4: Despite her military-like attitude, I found it odd that she's always in plain clothes. When asked about this, Canna says it's because she's always ready to go, whether she's in uniform or not. It does make sense, but then again, it sort of doesn't...
Album_Canna5: Canna always speaks in a clipped, military tone. When I asked her to speak normally, saying it sometimes makes things uncomfortable, she spent an entire day awkwardly speaking Middle English, as if she's in The Canterbury Tales.
Album_Canna6: I learned that Canna was originally affiliated with... the Colonial Conquest Army. The elves travel throughout space, colonizing a variety of places. When I asked if Elias was also a place they came to colonize, she said that wasn't the case. Canna affirmed that Elias was purely a place for emergency landings.
Album_Canna7: According to Canna's confession, the elves were originally sent to Earth for colonization. However, their plan failed when an agent, blessed by 50 stars, planted a virus in their spaceship. Captured and detained, the elves were forced into secret government factories as laborers. They eventually devised an escape plan, built a hidden dimensional gate, and barely managed to flee... And by pure coincidence, the place they escaped to was Elias.

LoveLetter_Canna: Hello, Master! This is Chief Canna of the Monatium Strike Force.I happened to get a rare day off and decided to use the time to write you this letter. Usually, handwritten letters are discouraged for security reasons, but since there's no sensitive information here, it should be fine. Probably. I wanted to take this chance to thank you for all the help and kindness you've—whoops, looks like I'm being summoned again. So much for my time off...If I ever get another day off, I'll be sure to write again! Let's hope that happens sooner rather than later.
LoveCall_Canna:
Master, have you been well? This is Canna, captain of the Monatium Suppression Unit.
While reviewing documents, I saw the word 'Order' and thought of you.
I wanted to personally thank you for always taking such good care of us Elves.

I learn a great deal from watching you always do your best at the same post.
I will strive to become an even better captain who sets an example for others, just as you do.
I have always appreciated how working with you lets us share responsibility.
I hope I have not placed an unnecessary burden on you! Hmm, Allet is calling me.
I shall end the call here. With gratitude for everything so far, and everything still to come! Canna.
